        ### Question
        During a study on the immune system, an investigator isolates and labels T cells from the cortex of the thymus. The T cells that do not bind cortical epithelial cells expressing MHC molecules undergo apoptosis within 3–4 days. Which of the following best describes the T cells during this phase of differentiation?

        ### Options
        opa. CD4+ and CD8+
opb. Th2
opc. CD8+
opd. T cell precursor
ope. CD4+

CHAIN: "T cell differentiation" -> "involves selection processes" -> "positive selection for MHC binding" -> "non-binding T cells undergo apoptosis" -> "results in CD4+ and CD8+ T cells" -> 90%
CHAIN: "T cell precursors" -> "migrate to the thymus" -> "differentiate in the thymic cortex" -> "undergo selection based on MHC binding" -> "those that do not bind undergo apoptosis" -> "CD4+ and CD8+ T cells emerge" -> 75%
